maintenance.title: Server maintenance
maintenance.banner: The server goes down for maintenance at %[2]s to update to %[1]s, for about %[3]d minutes. Please finish your battles before then.
maintenance.body:
Maintenance starts at %[2]s and updates the server to %[1]s. It should take about %[3]d minutes.
Please finish any battle or room before it starts; saved progress is not affected. See the update notes for what changes.
maintenance.login: The server is updating to %[1]s and should be back in about %[3]d minutes.
